item.title: Studio Ghibli, Bandai Namco, Square Enix Demand OpenAI to Stop Using Their IP
item.description:
📝 NewsAIEntertainmentStudio Ghibli, Bandai Namco, Square Enix demand OpenAI stop using their content to train AI﻿Japanese trade association CODA says Sora 2’s opt-out policy may have violated copyright law. ﻿Japanese trade association CODA says Sora 2’s opt-out policy may have violated copyright law. The Content Overseas Distribution Association (CODA), an anti-piracy organization representing Japanese IP holders like Studio Ghibli and Bandai Namco, released a letter last week asking OpenAI to stop using its members’ content to train Sora 2, as reported by Automaton.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theverge.com/news/812545/coda-studio-ghibli-sora-2-copyright-infringement

item.title: Bloom filters are good for search that does not scale
item.description:
📝 At each branch node, we construct an aggregate filter that encodes all documents that are reachable from the branch. the filter for document 6-10, we can discard that entire branch of the tree for this query. For our seach index that means that even when using this tree, we would still need to search almost every document for every query.
🔗 Read more: https://notpeerreviewed.com/blog/bloom-filters/
